cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Get docker network inspect for supabase
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("docker network inspect areloria_supabase 2>&1 | grep -A2 'Containers' | head -10")
print("Net:", stdout.read().decode())
# Check docker-compose
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ls /opt/areloria/*.yml /opt/areloria/*.yaml 2>&1")
print("YML:", stdout.read().decode())
client.close()
EOF
